"Fix the Eldoria build errors and correct the mobile joystick controls.

JOYSTICK DIRECTION FIX:

- Moving the analog joystick LEFT must move the character LEFT.
- Moving the analog joystick RIGHT must move the character RIGHT.
- Moving UP must move the character FORWARD.
- Moving DOWN must move the character BACKWARD.
- Fix any inverted horizontal or vertical input axis.
- Ensure joystick input coordinates match the character movement direction relative to the camera.
- Check the movement vector calculations and camera-relative controls.
- Ensure camera rotation does not accidentally reverse horizontal movement.
- Keep the joystick responsive, smooth, and consistent.

IMPORTANT:
Preserve the existing character, armor, animations, combat, stamina, vitality, quests, UI, terrain, and water systems.

Fix the existing code instead of rebuilding the entire game.

Test all four joystick directions before completing the build.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix Eldoria build issues and correct mobile joystick movement so all four directions remain camera-relative and intuitive.
- Preserve the existing game systems and test joystick directions before finishing.

## Requirements
- Joystick left/right move character left/right; up/down move forward/backward.
- Fix inverted axes and prevent camera rotation from reversing horizontal input.
- Keep controls responsive and smooth; preserve character, armor, animations, combat, stamina, vitality, quests, UI, terrain, and water.
- Test all four joystick directions; do not rebuild the game or ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Extracted movement input and camera-relative vector math into `getMoveInput()` and `cameraRelativeMove()` for explicit axis mapping and easier directional verification.
- Added a small joystick dead zone and pointer-ID-aware release handling for steadier touch input.
- Corrected the hero armor sphere geometry segment argument from `.16` to `16`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated the joystick and camera-relative movement calculations in `index.html`.
- Corrected the malformed armor geometry argument.
- Extracted the module script and ran `node --check` without syntax errors.

### Active
- Browser/game testing, including all four joystick directions at different camera yaws.
- Build verification and final change review.

### Blocked
- Initial browser test could not run because Chromium was not installed; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` completed successfully, so testing can now resume.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright using the Linux config and verify load/console errors.
2. Start the game in mobile viewport and test joystick left/right/up/down at multiple camera rotations; record measured movement deltas.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; run final checks and review `git diff`.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: game implementation and all changes.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`: browser launch configuration for Playwright checks.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game imports Three.js from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
